summary: Feature request to expose the upgrade-on-continue-as-new option and ContinueAsNewSuggestedReasons in all SDK implementations. This capability allows workflows to handle version upgrades when using continue-as-new patterns.
userImpact: SDK users need the ability to specify upgrade behaviors when continuing workflows as new, enabling safer version migrations.
proposedFix: Expose Upgrade-on-CaN option and ContinueAsNewSuggestedReasons across all SDK implementations, with reference implementation shown in Go SDK branch.
